mentions.name: ourrhythm.de
mentions.description: A privacy-first intimacy tracking website where users can log and keep up with their intimate activity, such as keeping pace with the 24 rounds of an erotic advent calendar.
mentions.problem: Spawned from wondering whether people who buy erotic advent calendars with 24 toys actually keep up with all 24 rounds.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building ourrhythm.de, a privacy first intimacy tracker spawned from a drunken thought: people buy those erotic advent calendars with 24 toys — do they actually keep up with all 24 rounds? It turned into a site idea.
